gumtree_entries.description:
ADDED i1: Tests the {@code DayOfYear.now(...)} factory methods.

Each test confirms that {@code DayOfYear.now} reports the same day-of-year as the {@link LocalDate} it
ADDED i2: Number of days in a standard (non-leap) year.
ADDED i3: A fixed time-zone used so the test does not depend on the machine's default zone.
ADDED i7: Pin the clock to the start of the current day in a fixed zone.
